disclaimer.normal_residence: Exchange usually requires that you were normally resident in the issuing country when (and often while) you held the licence, and that you are resident in the destination when you exchange. EU law defines normal residence as living in a place for at least 185 days in each calendar year (Directive 2006/126/EC Art. 12). A licence obtained without meeting that condition is often void in the destination.
disclaimer.scope: Lawful exchange conditions only. This is not a guide to licence tourism.
